Question 12

The equation z2−50=−10z can be written in the form (z+p)2=q. Find p+q, and solve the equation.

a
p+q=80,z=−8±3
b
p+q=−70,z=±3
c
p+q=80,z=−5±53
d
p+q=75,z=5±53
e
p+q=80,z=5±53
